label: Agoric Proposal 93 passes: 60-day Inter Protocol wind-down, IST minting halted
note: 2025-05-01: Agoric signaling Proposal 93 (submitted 2025-04-28) passed at voting end, mandating a planned 60-day Inter Protocol wind-down: no new vaults or IST minting, liquidation fee set to 0, weekly liquidation-ratio increases to close remaining vaults, and a June 30 shutdown target.

label: Inter Protocol sunset: IST redemption grace period ends
note: 2025-06-30: Inter Protocol sunset; IST redemption grace period ends.
